payload.title: Integrate durable mission events into the existing six-hour operator
payload.goal: Extend deterministic health automation with a fenced evidence/action adapter and no idle model polling.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Retain existing operator, kill switch, durable logs and six-hour trigger; add source_changed, source_review_due, completed_check_aggregate, program_terms_changed, commission_report_due, support_received and owner_direction events.
Persist mission job/experiment/action IDs, atomic checkpoint, evidence hash, next_check_at and decision fingerprint in shared authoritative store; public STATE stays sanitized projection.
Use one exclusive fenced owner for effect scopes; Actions concurrency alone is not cross-host authority, and Windows must not become duplicate scheduler.
Dispatch only admitted source review, guide correction, eligibility refresh, aggregate collection and support draft actions; route external publication/referrals/messages through qualified adapters.
Bound retries and queue size and return deterministic no-action for unchanged evidence; migrate legacy state with dated provenance rather than erasing it.
tests: 100 identical due polls yield zero model calls and no duplicate source-review job.
Simultaneous owner claims accept one token; stale token cannot publish a correction or activate affiliate link.
Crash before/after checkpoint retains one action intent and consistent source/event cursor.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: Existing six-hour operator is preserved or explicitly fenced into the new adapter under its owner.
Changed/due evidence selects useful work automatically and records verified result/next check.
payload.rollback: Pause new adapter, reconcile uncertain effects, leave old qualified health operator authoritative until explicit transfer.
payload.next_eligible_action: Build mission-specific event mapping against shared runtime fixtures without attaching production schedule.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Shared store/claims and host capability integration are required only for broader autonomy, not beta release.
